# QuerySprint

> QuerySprint teaches three linked SQL reporting tasks against two fictional orders datasets, using a real SQLite engine in the browser.

Free browser tools. Paid features are not available.

Three beginner exercises, not a complete course or job credential. Educational revenue definition is paid order value minus refunds; this is not an accounting revenue-recognition system.
